purpose: Separate a data-only learning curve from promotion of a replacement preview. Record before scoring any added-data fit.

learningCurve.baseline: converged baseline stage, not the old 400-iteration preview
learningCurve.vary: training run membership only; fixed gates, architecture, physical calibration and normalized ridge objective
learningCurve.nonconverged: diagnostic only; do not interpret as a matched-convergence data comparison

promotionChecks: pooled median absolute band-level error improves
pooled worst absolute band-level error improves
absolute 200-400 Hz level error does not worsen on either validation run
rankEligible: smallest worst absolute 200-400 Hz level error across validation runs
selection.ifNoneEligible: Freeze the converged candidate with the smallest worst validation 200-400 Hz error for diagnostic testing only; do not replace a game asset.

finalEvaluation.oldKnownFailure: diagnostic-known-failure is not a fresh test
finalEvaluation.runtime: Any proposed game asset must additionally pass native/WASM pressure agreement and actual streaming performance checks.
